priorState: PARTIALLY_VALIDATED — 'Attachment pills render live in thread, but the send/open/download journey per attachment type has not been exercised.'
freshLiveEvidence: Founder live observation on attributable artifact 36036643: generic Attachment pills, document identity not surfaced, attachments not openable from the visible object, generic message actions substituting for attachment actions.
theDefect: Every attachment that was not an image, voice note or video rendered as _fileChip('Attachment') — a grey pill with a paperclip, the literal word 'Attachment', and nothing else: no file name, no type, no size, no tap target. A PDF, a spreadsheet, a deck and a zip were indistinguishable from one another AND from the failure state, which used the same chip. Images rendered but had no open action.
rootCauseOfTheNamelessness: The backend conversation projection selected only { id, type, mimeType }. The client could not show a file name because it was never sent one. CH-11 had already resolved the media truth from the bytes; it simply never reached the surface.

implementation.backend: src/conversations/conversations.service.ts — the media projection now also selects fileName and fileSizeBytes and carries them through kindOf. Additive; no schema change, no migration.
implementation.newWidget: lib/core/media/aura_attachment_card.dart — AttachmentPresentationKind (10 kinds), attachmentKindFrom() resolving from the RESOLVED mime with the coarse canonical kind only as fallback, humanFileSize(), and AuraAttachmentCard rendering icon + file name + kind label + size + kind-appropriate action.
implementation.newHelper: lib/core/media/aura_attachment_open.dart — one place that hands a non-renderable file to the platform, with a visible failure message instead of a silent no-op.
implementation.conversationRenderer: Images now open in the canonical AuraMediaViewer on tap (the 'seen but cannot be opened' observation). Audio/video keep playback. Everything else renders the card with its real identity and action. The unavailable state keeps the file's identity instead of degrading to the word 'Attachment'.

honestyRules: An archive offers Download, not Open — nothing in-app can open a zip and offering to would be a false offer.
An unrecognised type is labelled 'File', which states that the kind is unrecognised. 'Attachment' stated nothing at all.
Size is omitted when unknown rather than printed as 0 B.
No action is rendered when the file cannot be opened — a button that does nothing is worse than no button.
The unavailable state keeps the file name, so a person still knows what is missing.
No document preview or thumbnail is invented — rendering a preview the client cannot verify would be the same dishonesty in a nicer shape.

boundaryDiscipline.ch11NotReopened: CH-11 media truth is CONSUMED, not re-decided. attachmentKindFrom reads the resolved mime; it never re-classifies bytes.
boundaryDiscipline.unrelatedSurfaces: Only the Conversation attachment renderer was changed. Correspondence, posts, announcements and article composers were not touched.
boundaryDiscipline.meetings: Untouched. 137 frontend gate/Meetings tests and 120 backend meeting/conversation tests pass.

tests: test/media/aura_attachment_card_test.dart — 13 assertions covering kind resolution across every permitted document family, mime-wins-over-coarse-kind, honest action labels, size formatting and omission, real identity rendering, tappability, and the two failure presentations.
notClaimed: F011 is NOT closed. Its canonical remainder is the send/open/download journey EXERCISED per type, which is live evidence.
